subject: [hw] R1: F19 verified fixed; V32 rev 6 accepted (13149/13149)
body: Re-ran shim/test_v32/run_tests.sh on rev 6: N2TEST V32 PASS 13149/13149, with the TSan e2e now 10730/10730 and direct 2390/2390. F19 is closed in review/r1/FINDINGS.md; V32 is accept. The interruptible-wait change is a real improvement for teardown (a blocked join/sem/cond can now be broken by abort/stop_request). No other V32 finding; F8 remains on V02s side.
